verdict.rationale: Belvo documents a public REST API. The evidence shows a published OpenAPI spec page covering many API families, API-key onboarding with a Postman collection, and reference docs for pagination, filtering, async workflows, webhooks and error codes, plus an llms.txt. Community commenters independently praised the clean API and the ready-made Postman collection. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI JSON at the standard paths (probe returned 404s), and no hands-on evidence of an agent driving the API end to end.
